# Data table (`data-table`)

Sortable, selectable, sticky, dense, resizable columns.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createDataTable` (types in `dist/web/data-display/dataTable.d.ts`): `.mh-data-table` (`--dense`, `--striped`, `--sticky-header`, `--sticky-column`, `--selectable`): a focusable, scrolling `role="region"` around a native `table.mh-data-table__table` with a caption. Sortable headers hold a `button.mh-data-table__sort` (`aria-sort` on the `th`); resizable ones a `.mh-data-table__resize` separator (drag, or Left / Right with Shift for bigger steps). Selection adds a checkbox column with select-all; selected rows get `.is-selected`.

```ts
export function createDataTable<T>(options: DataTableOptions<T>): DataTableHandle<T>;

export interface DataTableOptions<T> {
  columns: readonly DataTableColumn<T>[];
  rows: readonly T[];
  /** A stable id per row (selection, keys). */
  rowId: (row: T) => string;
  /** Required: the table's name, also its caption. */
  label: string;
  /** Shows the caption above the table (default hidden, read by screen readers). */
  showCaption?: boolean;
  sort?: DataTableSort | null;
  onSortChange?: (sort: DataTableSort) => void;
  /** A checkbox column with select-all in the header. */
  selectable?: boolean;
  selected?: readonly string[];
  onSelectionChange?: (selected: string[]) => void;
  /** Names a row for its checkbox ("Select Kitchen light"); default the first column's value. */
  rowLabel?: (row: T) => string;
  /** Every column can be resized. */
  resizable?: boolean;
  onColumnResize?: (column: string, width: number) => void;
  /** Tighter rows. */
  dense?: boolean;
  /** Alternate row shading. */
  striped?: boolean;
  /** The header stays put while the body scrolls (default true; needs `maxHeight`). */
  stickyHeader?: boolean;
  /** The first column stays put while the table scrolls sideways. */
  stickyColumn?: boolean;
  /** A CSS length; the body scrolls inside it ("24rem", "60vh"). */
  maxHeight?: string;
  /** Shown in place of the rows when there are none. Default "Nothing to show". */
  empty?: string;
}

export interface DataTableHandle<T> {
  el: HTMLElement;
  setRows(rows: readonly T[]): void;
  sort(): DataTableSort | null;
  setSort(sort: DataTableSort | null): void;
  selected(): string[];
  setSelected(ids: readonly string[]): void;
  /** Current widths of resized columns, by id. */
  columnWidths(): Record<string, number>;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createDataTable, createText, type DataTableColumn } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

interface Device {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  room: string;
  battery: number;
}

const devices: Device[] = [
  { id: 'd1', name: 'Hall motion sensor', room: 'Hallway', battery: 82 },
  { id: 'd2', name: 'Front door lock', room: 'Hallway', battery: 9 },
  { id: 'd3', name: 'Kitchen window', room: 'Kitchen', battery: 67 },
  { id: 'd4', name: 'Bedroom radiator', room: 'Bedroom', battery: 23 },
];

const columns: DataTableColumn<Device>[] = [
  { id: 'name', label: 'Name', sortable: true },
  { id: 'room', label: 'Room', sortable: true },
  { id: 'battery', label: 'Battery', align: 'end', sortable: true, render: (d) => `${d.battery}%` },
];

const status = createText('Nothing selected', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const table = createDataTable({
  columns,
  rows: devices,
  rowId: (d) => d.id,
  rowLabel: (d) => d.name,
  label: 'Devices',
  selectable: true,
  sort: { column: 'name', direction: 'ascending' },
  onSelectionChange: (ids) => {
    status.textContent = ids.length ? `${ids.length} selected` : 'Nothing selected';
  },
});

document.body.append(table.el, status);
```

## React API

`DataTable` (types in `dist/react/data-display.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createDataTable`; sort and selection controlled or uncontrolled, widths kept inside.

```ts
export function DataTable<T>({
  columns,
  rows,
  rowId,
  label,
  showCaption,
  sort,
  defaultSort = null,
  onSortChange,
  selectable,
  selected,
  defaultSelected,
  onSelectionChange,
  rowLabel,
  resizable,
  onColumnResize,
  dense,
  striped,
  stickyHeader = true,
  stickyColumn,
  maxHeight,
  empty = 'Nothing to show',
  className,
}: DataTableProps<T>);

export interface DataTableProps<T> {
  columns: readonly DataTableColumnProps<T>[];
  rows: readonly T[];
  rowId: (row: T) => string;
  label: string;
  showCaption?: boolean;
  /** Controlled sort. */
  sort?: DataTableSort | null;
  defaultSort?: DataTableSort | null;
  onSortChange?: (sort: DataTableSort) => void;
  selectable?: boolean;
  /** Controlled selection. */
  selected?: readonly string[];
  defaultSelected?: readonly string[];
  onSelectionChange?: (selected: string[]) => void;
  rowLabel?: (row: T) => string;
  resizable?: boolean;
  onColumnResize?: (column: string, width: number) => void;
  dense?: boolean;
  striped?: boolean;
  stickyHeader?: boolean;
  stickyColumn?: boolean;
  maxHeight?: string;
  empty?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

export interface DataTableColumnProps<T> extends Omit<DataTableColumn<T>, 'render'> {
  render?: (row: T) => ReactNode;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { DataTable, type DataTableColumnProps } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { DataTableSort } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

interface Device {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  room: string;
  battery: number;
}

const devices: Device[] = [
  { id: 'd1', name: 'Hall motion sensor', room: 'Hallway', battery: 82 },
  { id: 'd2', name: 'Front door lock', room: 'Hallway', battery: 9 },
  { id: 'd3', name: 'Kitchen window', room: 'Kitchen', battery: 67 },
  { id: 'd4', name: 'Bedroom radiator', room: 'Bedroom', battery: 23 },
];

const columns: DataTableColumnProps<Device>[] = [
  { id: 'name', label: 'Name', sortable: true },
  { id: 'room', label: 'Room', sortable: true },
  { id: 'battery', label: 'Battery', align: 'end', sortable: true, render: (d) => `${d.battery}%` },
];

export function DataTableExample() {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<DataTableSort>({ column: 'name', direction: 'ascending' });
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>([]);
  return (
    <DataTable
      columns={columns}
      rows={devices}
      rowId={(d) => d.id}
      rowLabel={(d) => d.name}
      label="Devices"
      sort={sort}
      onSortChange={setSort}
      selectable
      selected={selected}
      onSelectionChange={setSelected}
    />
  );
}
```
